zh-CN.title: 科研协作流程与布局升级
items: 课题采用列表与详情面板，群聊可直接在科研内打开
好友接受邀请卡片后才加入课题，随后引导连接日历和确认全局忙闲权限
支持类别组精细权限，优化负责人转让入口、任务日期和统一空状态

en.title: A more cohesive research workspace
items: Projects open beside the list, with real group conversations inside research
Join through invitation cards, then connect your calendar and confirm global busy/free sharing
Fine-tune category permissions with clearer ownership actions, dates and empty states
